title: Four cyclic fields with occupancy after exact noise-weight removals with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit 4-field degree-250 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-55 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 13794183530587107/250000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=28312051118772337549502193655624318229445794497762395454521402183950292957560795168 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(2739/10).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all ten averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3).
